observations.text: SP, due to a late round-out from a high final approach and an aim point that was not reset after the pitch out, did not arrest the sink rate at the flare and did not fly the touchdown speed schedule. Touchdown with FLAPS LDG occurred about 2100 feet from the beginning of the runway, well beyond the 1500 feet limit, at 12 knots above the touchdown speed and about 20 feet right of the center line. The IP took the controls, directed the go-around and flew the corrective pattern. Repetition of the landing sequence with emphasis on aim point and flare initiation is required.

SP, due to failure to call the go-around once the approach was no longer stable, continued a drifting final instead of terminating it and did not re-establish either the aim point or the wings-level touchdown attitude. The aircraft touched down with FLAPS UP about 2600 feet from the beginning of the runway, beyond the 2000 feet limit, about 25 feet left of the center line and 14 knots above the touchdown speed. The IP intervened on the controls and completed the landing roll-out. Go-around decision criteria are to be restated before the next formation recovery.

SP, due to an abrupt power reduction in the flare and a cross-controlled correction against the crosswind, did not maintain the runway center line and did not hold the touchdown speed schedule. Touchdown with FLAPS LDG occurred at 1500 feet from the beginning of the runway, 15 feet right of the center line and 10 knots above the touchdown speed. Both the float and the lateral drift were recognized and corrected with delay, only after the IP's verbal prompts.

SP, due to inadequate monitoring of airspeed during the approach, did not fly the final approach speed schedule and carried the excess energy into the flare. The aircraft floated and touched down with FLAPS T/O at 1500 feet from the beginning of the runway, 10 knots above the touchdown speed and 15 feet left of the center line. The deviations were identified and corrected only after the IP's verbal prompts, with delayed recognition. A renewed emphasis on the airspeed cross-check inside the final turn is required.

SP, due to a slightly long aim point and a small delay in the power reduction, did not establish the touchdown attitude at the first attempt and allowed a brief float. Touchdown with FLAPS LDG occurred about 1250 feet from the beginning of the runway, 8 feet left of the center line and 7 knots above the touchdown speed. The deviations were recognized and corrected in a timely manner during the roll-out, without IP's intervention.

SP, due to distraction by radio traffic while established on final, did not complete the lineup correction before the flare and drifted from the runway center line. Touchdown with FLAPS UP occurred about 1750 feet from the beginning of the runway, 9 feet right of the center line and 8 knots above the touchdown speed. The drift was detected and corrected in a timely manner, with the aircraft tracking the assigned side of the runway for the remainder of the roll-out and without IP's intervention.

SP landed within the desired standards, touching down with FLAPS LDG about 950 feet from the beginning of the runway, 5 feet off the center line and at 5 knots above the touchdown speed, that is at the upper edge of the permitted band. The aim point was held on each pattern, but the flare was initiated late on two of the three landings and the excess speed was bled off during the float rather than on final. Marginal performance for the Training Section - tighter airspeed control on final and earlier flare initiation are expected to improve consistency.

SP flew every landing with the aim point held and the touchdown attitude fully established, touching down with FLAPS LDG consistently within 700 feet of the beginning of the runway, on the center line and at the computed touchdown speed. Deviations in lineup and in touchdown speed were negligible throughout, and directional control on the roll-out was maintained with correct spacing behind the preceding aircraft and without IP's intervention. Above end of block MIF achieved.
